formulas.formula: Your whole year in dark mode: plan once, log your spending, see every month at a glance.
Fills in from the year above (this year if blank).
To change it, select the money cells and use Format > Number.
1. In YOUR SETUP, type your budget year. Every tab follows it.
2. Open Budget Plan. Rename the categories to fit your life and type a Monthly Amount for each.
3. Log every paycheck and purchase on Transactions: date, category (pick from the list) and amount.
4. Year at a Glance: every category, every month, on one page. Switch between Actual, Plan and Difference.
5. Dashboard: your whole year. Monthly Dashboard: pick any month for its own cards and charts.
6. Year Summary has totals, averages and the month-by-month table behind the charts.
7. Once a month, update Savings Goals and Debt Payoff (current balance).
8. Got a refund? Log it as a negative amount in the same category.
9. The example numbers show a whole year. To start fresh, go to Transactions, select columns A to F
from row 2 down and press Delete (don't delete the rows). Then type over the other examples.
Your whole year at a glance: totals, savings rate, charts, top categories.
Pick a month: its own cards, budget vs. actual and top spending.
Every category and every month on one page: Actual, Plan or Difference.
Your categories and how much you plan for each one, every month of the year.
One list for every paycheck and purchase. Everything else reads from here.
Totals, monthly averages and plan so far for every category.
Long-term goals with progress bars, fed by your savings transactions.
Your debts, how much you paid down, interest paid and months left.
Plain dark cells: type your numbers here.
Lighter blue cells: these calculate for you. No typing needed.
Red: something to check (over budget, a missing category, text in a number cell).
Green: on track or better than planned.
Log purchases as they happen, or set a 10-minute money date once a week.
Plan for yearly costs (gifts, insurance, memberships) as a small amount every month.
Pay yourself first: move money to savings on payday, before you spend.
Over budget in a category? Move money from another category instead of giving up.
Check the Dashboard at the end of each month and adjust next month's plan.
Buy with a credit card? Log each purchase in its category. Under Debt, log only what you pay toward an old balance, so nothing counts twice.
Thank you for your purchase! Easy on the eyes, clear on the numbers.
Everything here updates from your Transactions tab.
Tip: if something looks off, check 'Transactions to fix' above and the Check column on Transactions.
Pick a month. Everything below follows it. It all comes from Transactions.
Pick from the list, or type 3 letters like Sep.
Spending vs. last month: + means you spent less than the month before.
=IF(INDEX('Year Summary'!$D$67:$O$67,1,$Q$3)=0,"No transactions logged for this month yet.",INDEX('Year Summary'!$D$67:$O$67,1,$Q$3)&" transactions logged this month.")
Every category, every month. Switch the view: Actual (from Transactions), Plan (from Budget Plan) or Difference (+ is better than plan).
Difference view: + means better than plan (more income or savings, less spending). - means worse.
Plan So Far and vs. Plan count only the months you've logged transactions in.
Type a Monthly Amount and it fills every month. Different in one month? Type over that month (it turns blue). Rename categories, but don't insert or delete rows.
Red category name: it's listed twice, has amounts but no name, or uses * ? ~ or starts with < > = (rename it).
Left to Plan: green = every dollar has a job, yellow = money not planned yet, red = planned more than you earn.

=IF(AND(A{row}="",B{row}="",D{row}=""),"",IF(OR(NOT(ISNUMBER(A{row})),N(A{row})<1,N(A{row})>2958465),"Check the date",IF(YEAR(A{row})<>'Start Here'!$D$8,"Not in "&'Start Here'!$D$8,IF(B{row}="","Pick a category",IF(G{row}="Not found","Category not on Budget Plan",IF(D{row}="","Add an amount",IF(NOT(ISNUMBER(D{row})),"Amount must be a number","OK")))))))
Filled in automatically from Transactions. Nothing to type here. Budget So Far = your plan for the months that have transactions.
Pick a goal from your Savings categories (or type your own), then add the Target and what you had saved on January 1 (Starting Balance).
Added This Year fills in from Transactions: every transfer you log to that category counts.
Monthly Plan comes from Budget Plan (the category's year total divided by 12).
Tip: build a starter emergency fund of $1,000 first, then grow it to 3-6 months of expenses.
Pick a debt from your Debt categories, then type the balance on January 1, the interest rate (22.99 or 22.99%) and, once a month, the Current Balance from your statement.
Paid This Year fills in from Transactions. Interest & Charges = what you paid minus how much the balance went down (interest, fees and any new purchases). Keep Current Balance up to date.
Monthly Payment comes from Budget Plan. Months Left assumes you keep paying that amount.
Snowball: pay extra on Payoff Order 1 (the smallest balance) first. When it's gone, roll its payment into the next one.
'Payment too low' means the payment doesn't cover the monthly interest yet. A rate under 1%? Type it with the % sign, like 0.9%.

formula: OR($K2="Payment too low",$K2="Add it to Budget Plan",$K2="Fix a payment")
